businesses.name: Flood Park
businesses.label: Flood Park
businesses.tagline: An inclusive playground, courts, picnic areas and pump track in Menlo Park.
businesses.contactOnly: Visit the county park website for facilities, closures and picnic reservations.

panels.head: Park hours
body: Opens daily at 8 am. County seasonal schedule: closes at 6 pm October 12–November 1, 2026; closes at 5 pm November 2, 2026–February 2027. Map screenshots may show older hours.

panels.head: Playground and facilities
body: Inclusive playground, sports courts, picnic areas and pump track. The county says the playground is open; the ribbon cutting is November 10. Check the county for closures and reservation availability.

businesses.name: Bay Area Discovery Museum
businesses.label: Discovery Museum
businesses.tagline: Hands-on discovery and outdoor play for ages 0–8 at Fort Baker.
businesses.quoteOnly: Buy tickets from the museum. Special events have separate prices and terms.

groups.name: Admission programs
items: EBT / SNAP / WIC admission (up to 4 people)

panels.head: Visiting hours
body: Wednesday–Friday 10 am–4 pm; Saturday 9 am–4 pm; Sunday 10 am–4 pm. Closed Monday–Tuesday during the school year. The second Thursday of each month closes at 3 pm. Members-only early access is separate.

panels.head: Tickets and families
body: Children under 1 enter free. Ages 0–8 are the museum’s intended audience. Adult supervision is required; one adult per five children. Free parking and an on-site café. Discounts have eligibility requirements; check the museum before booking.

panels.head: October films
body: These Goblin Jamboree films are archival October footage. That event has ended. General admission prices do not apply to special events.

clip.credit: Filmed by @polynesianmomx3 · Archival October Goblin Jamboree footage; the event has ended. Check current museum tickets.

businesses.name: Half Moon Play
businesses.label: Half Moon Play
businesses.tagline: Indoor play and parties for children ages 0–9 in Half Moon Bay.
businesses.address: 50 Cabrillo Hwy N, Suite B4A, Half Moon Bay, CA 94019
businesses.quoteOnly: Check current hours and arrange admission or parties directly with Half Moon Play.

panels.head: Hours and Sunday changes
body: Monday–Thursday 10 am–6 pm; Friday 10 am–7 pm; Saturday 9 am–7 pm. Sunday is listed as 9 am–6 pm, with a notice that Sundays will soon be private parties only. Confirm before traveling.

panels.head: Play and membership
body: A pre-walker is free with a paid child; one adult per family is included with daily admission. Grip socks are required. Membership includes one two-hour visit each day and two adults; additional adults are $5. Members receive the operator’s published 15% birthday-party discount; confirm terms directly.

businesses.name: Peek-a-Boo Factory — Rancho Cordova
businesses.label: Peek-a-Boo Factory
businesses.tagline: Three levels of play, a toddler area and an obstacle course in Rancho Cordova.
businesses.address: 11270 Sanders Dr, Suite A, Rancho Cordova, CA 95742
businesses.quoteOnly: Confirm the daily calendar and book directly. Party food below is the operator’s tray/package menu.

groups.name: Party food packages
items: Pizza package — 2 XL cheese pizzas and 10 juices

panels.head: Check the daily calendar
body: The live calendar and the static hours/rates page publish different closing times. Confirm today’s hours before traveling.

panels.head: Play rules and passes
body: Grip socks and waivers are required. Passes may be shared by siblings only and are nonrefundable and nontransferable. Membership requires at least one month. Arrange admission and any waiver with the venue.

panels.head: Shanna’s visit
body: Family-outing film by Shanna, @outdoorideaswithkids, as requested by Glenn.

businesses.label: El Dorado Orchards

businesses.contactOnly: Seasonal family farm. Buy train tickets on site; no current fare is published on the official website.

panels.head: Seasonal visits
body: The farm lists Friday–Sunday 9 am–5 pm during harvest season. This is not a year-round schedule. Confirm operating dates before traveling. Rain or damp tracks can stop train service.

clip.credit: Filmed by @duhhhh_13 · Seasonal harvest visit; confirm the farm and train schedule before traveling.

businesses.contactOnly: Check the City of Sunnyvale for park facilities, reservations and closures.

panels.head: Park facilities
body: Inclusive playground, ballfields, basketball and tennis courts, picnic areas, skate ramps and pathways. Park hours are 6 am–9 pm; court lighting can run until 10 pm.

businesses.name: Ricky Baba
businesses.label: Ricky Baba
businesses.tagline: Unofficial AI animation and nostalgic fan stories by @rickybaba.

It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Capcom or Street Fighter. Contact the creator on Instagram; no service prices are published.

businesses.name: Red Eye Barbecue
businesses.label: Red Eye Barbecue
businesses.tagline: Smoked meats, sandwiches and sides at Epicenter in Santa Rosa.
businesses.quoteOnly: Order or confirm availability directly with Red Eye Barbecue. Prices are from its own published menus.

sections.name: Kids meals
items: Mini corn dog bites and fries

panels.head: Kitchen and venue hours
body: Barbecue service starts at noon. Venue hours: Monday–Thursday noon–10 pm; Friday noon–midnight; Saturday 11 am–midnight; Sunday 9 am–10 pm. Monday–Thursday and Sunday kitchen closes at 9 pm. Confirm Friday event-dependent kitchen closing.

panels.head: Menu availability
body: Full menu Wednesday–Sunday; Monday–Tuesday limited menu includes beef cheek, sausage, wings, turkey and the published sides, sandwiches and desserts. Brisket and beef ribs are Saturday–Sunday only; other meats can sell out. Add sausage to chips and queso for $6 or smoked chicken to a salad for $6. Kids meals for adults add $2; swap fries for yogurt or applesauce for $1.

businesses.name: Jin Pot Shabu House
businesses.label: Jin Pot
businesses.tagline: Individual hot pots and all-you-can-eat shabu in San Francisco’s Richmond District.
businesses.quoteOnly: Reserve or order directly with Jin Pot. Confirm current prices and AYCE conditions with the restaurant.

sections.name: Broths
items: Spicy garlic organic soy milk miso

panels.head: AYCE conditions
body: The published menu lists a 90-minute limit, one AYCE option for the entire party, no takeout and charges for wasted food. Children under 3 are listed free, ages 4–9 have a child price and ages 10+ pay regular price; ask about age 3. Parties of six or more have a 20% taxable service charge. Confirm all terms with the restaurant.

panels.head: Menus and film prices
body: The older promotional film shows a different price from the currently linked menu. Confirm current prices directly. The alcohol-inclusive Ultimate package and alcoholic drinks are not offered through BEASTY.

clips.credit: Posted by @jinpotshabu · Older promotional repost; prices in the video differ from the current published menu. Confirm with Jin Pot.

businesses.name: KidTopia — Dublin
businesses.label: KidTopia
businesses.tagline: Indoor play, parties and memberships for ages 6 months–12 years in Dublin.
businesses.quoteOnly: Book directly with KidTopia. Confirm current slots and complete any required waiver with the venue.

panels.head: Hours and sessions
body: Weekdays 10 am–7:30 pm. Weekend slots: 10 am–noon, 12:30–2:30 pm, 3–5 pm, 5:30–7:30 pm. Socks and waivers are required.

panels.head: Party details
body: Birthday child and parents are included. Packages include a private room and host, child juice and water. Bring food and cake without a fee; drinks must be purchased from KidTopia. Extra children cost $18 weekdays or $20 weekends, extra adults $5. Package 3 is marked coming soon.

panels.head: Pass and membership terms
body: The 10-visit pass does not expire; siblings may share it, using one visit per child. It includes up to two adults per visit, weekday full-day play or one weekend slot. Memberships renew manually, without automatic billing; active terms cannot be frozen or canceled. Private parties and selected holidays are excluded. Confirm terms before buying.
